scene: The scooped-up carp spits three transit tokens across sunny Piazza Nova.
picture: In side view along the piazza stones, a red double-decker hover bus idles far left. Centre, the silver-haired grandmother holds a dripping brass carp beside the stone fountain while her white dog watches. To the right floats a yellow gondola drone, and far right stands a glowing chrome hover metro turnstile.
shown: a red double-decker hover bus waiting with open doors on the far left
a yellow gondola drone moored beside a mooring post on the right
a gleaming chrome hover metro turnstile standing open on the far right
